qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Roughly half of Indra's revenue stems from Minsait, a commoditized IT consulting and software development business facing intense competition, low pricing power, and rising wage inflation. 5-year average ROIC (~11.5%) falls short of the 12% hurdle. High customer concentration in competitive Spanish public sector tenders.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3 (Moat Archetype 'None', ROIC < 12%). Roughly 50% of revenue stems from Minsait, a commoditized IT services and consulting business lacking durable pricing power. 5-year average ROIC (~11.5%) fails the 12% hurdle, compounded by heavy state governance interference from SEPI.
qualitative.evidence: 5-year average ROIC of ~11.5% (7.0% in 2021, 9.5% in 2022) falls short of the 12% hurdle. Minsait constitutes ~50% of revenue in low-margin, billable-hour IT consulting vulnerable to wage inflation and margin erosion. Defense contracts are heavily concentrated in Spanish government procurement subject to political intervention by state-owned SEPI (25%+ owner).
